definition: Landmark XYZ and LiDAR trajectory frozen. Frames about0.3s and0.6s after the fourth training view are held out from triangulation. LK forward/backward correspondence gate0.8px; original2px reprojection gate used only for evaluation, not fitting.
interpretation: Predictive image consistency is not absolute pose accuracy or proof of real physical surfaces; no pose or landmark fitting performed using held-out views.
signed_error_interpretation: Residual direction is examined descriptively only; coherent signed offsets can arise from calibration/planar-pose mismatch, baseline landmark depth uncertainty or coherent tracking error. No calibration, camera pose or landmark refit is performed.
